d: In this video, Firstpost takes a look at Warren Buffett's surprising confession about his drinking habits. The billionaire investor and philanthropist says he has not drunk water in 48 years, relying instead on Cherry Coke and regular Coca-Cola. His unusual claim has left the internet stunned, with many wondering how he has managed to go nearly five decades without drinking water. Is this the secret to his extraordinary success, or simply a billionaire's bizarre personal habit? One thing is certain: Buffett's financial wisdom may be worth following, but his hydration advice is another…
